# Highlight

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Highlight`](gmeow-Highlight.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Highlight>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

An annotation that marks an anchored span within a target and carries no body — a pure target+selector binding motivated by highlighting.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Highlight`](gmeow-Highlight.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
